summary: Show the canonical startup context injected into new agent sessions.

help:
Usage: mandates [OPTIONS]

  Show the canonical startup context injected into new agent sessions.

  Examples:
    st mandates
    st mandates --full
    st mandates --surface codex
    st --no-compact mandates

Options:
  --surface <str>       Consumer surface (default: injected contract or
                        detected harness)
  --full                Print the rendered context text
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

usage.when: verify the startup context Agent Hub injects (blocks, tokens, injected-hash match)
